subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should Discord get an opt-in autoThread follow-up mention gate, and should its public API be a Slack-style `thread.requireExplicitMention` option or a per-channel `requireMentionInThreadReplies` option?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public Discord config surface and changes which thread replies reach the agent, so automation should not choose the permanent API/default semantics on its own.

options.title: Add opt-in explicit thread replies
options.body: Introduce a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for autoThread follow-up replies while preserving current starter and existing-user behavior.

options.title: Fold into the broader thread override
options.body: Resolve this only as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/75938, accepting that starter-versus-follow-up semantics need to be designed with parent/thread overrides.

options.title: Keep current continuation
options.body: Decline a new Discord config surface and document that bot-owned autoThreads intentionally continue without mentions.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in explicit thread replies
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for autoThread follow-up replies while preserving current starter and existing-user behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across shared mention gating, Discord preflight routing, and the compatibility-sensitive channel config policy involved in this choice.
